designation: F124-H scientific development; distinct from FORGE autonomy F124/F125; no revised F124-F claims
negative_observation: F124-F fixed 3 records retain correct public causal history 48/48 positives in both lanes and both learned arms, yet paired correct Wingless A/B 2/48, Yggdrasil A 3/48/B 7/48. Every 5-hop cohort 0/24 paired. Depth shifts target score even when causal edge removal changes score. F124-G posthoc label-informed threshold only 22–24/48. Preserve original weights and findings.
hypothesis: Learned locally centered positive compatibility evidence versus independent competing compatibility evidence, accumulated as a per-step signed mean, will reduce depth-dependent output drift and translate retained raw-key histories into causal decisions under bounded 3-slot memory.

mechanisms.A: Keep exactly 3 public-key records/node; learn 16-bit raw compatibility weights and a TRAIN-learned per-comparison null evidence offset. Accumulate signed key compatibility into an arithmetic mean over compared hops, select highest evidence terminal record and classify via a learned sigmoid head; do NOT use summed path mass or implicit log-mass decay.
mechanisms.B: Same 3-slot raw-key records and signed mean as A; additionally learn a scalar multiplier for the difference between a candidate compatibility and a log-mean-exp competing same-source, same-role outgoing compatibility. Competing evidence is computed solely from public graph and each record's key, never the true route.
mechanisms.capacity: Both have 3 records per node, <=128 live messages per hop and <=128 total live records, <=64 nodes, <=128 public directed edges; one nondifferentiable top-k selection based on public next-role query compatibility, with gradient checked only on actually selected records.
mechanisms.training: 100 fixed epochs, cyclic four distinct paired TRAIN examples/epoch (8 labels), same frozen 0.5 sigmoid binary decision; 0.5 BCE plus 0.5 softplus(-positive/negative logit gap), clipped SGD, no holdout retuning. TRAIN paired-correct A/B selector with A winning ties.
mechanisms.parameters: A: 20 trainable scalars (16 independent raw bit weights, compatibility bias, null offset, head slope, head intercept). B: 21 (same plus competition coefficient); maximum 128; no exact equality bit or oracle path feature.

cohorts.confirm_gate: Reserve; not built, opened, tuned on or dispatched until independent authorized first-use.

source.identity: New independent graph salt and disjoint source seed, node-role identities and 16-bit token draws; no original F124-F TRAIN data is used in selecting parameters.
source.pairs: Same public graph field whitelist as F124-F; 4–5 hop TRAIN dual reconvergence, wrong-role alias, near-collision, parallel multiedges, repeated-key decoys. Negative swaps a necessary source slot with an off-role decoy preserving public topology, query, entire token histogram and degree; independent symbolic source admission one true positive and zero true negative.
source.controls: Fix 12-of-16 public raw-bit approximate matcher, role/depth/topology-only, token-histogram-only, exact public symbolic ceiling separately. No fabricated comparable operation budget.
source.anti_leak: Public observation has only start,target,roles,edges[from,to,role,src_bits,dst_bits]; no true route, oracle, source seed, precomputed equality, ground-truth path ID, or intervention location.

evaluation.development_primary: TRAIN paired correctness and balanced binary correctness for 0.5 frozen threshold, separately for Wingless/Yggdrasil and 4/5 hops; report positive-higher-relative ranking but never replace primary with ranking.
evaluation.scientific_first_use: Only independent original prospective reserved 7–9 hop after source, weight, control and first-use authorization. Synthetic TRAIN never an accepted original result.
evaluation.candidate_positive: At least +0.05 paired accuracy vs strongest eligible equally-resourced nonlearned comparator in BOTH lanes, no alias or near-collision harm, and independent causal intervention alignment. A failure must remain negative.
evaluation.mechanistic: Causal join-edge deletion vs distractor deletion, query-priority ablation, depth strata, terminal evidence mean distributions, raw carried-key retention; all computed with frozen weights after TRAIN and explicitly non-acceptance.
evaluation.resource: Public edge scans, raw bit multiply-adds, exp/sigmoid, memory records, messages, serialized parameters; never assert equal cost without demonstrated equivalence.
evaluation.custody: Record freeze Git blob before implementation, source and model exact Git blobs, parent negative receipt IDs, authenticated original vectors, immutable weights, cross-platform source tests and one full regression.
